Luxuryline PR and BRU CHARTERS operate in premium business segments, including luxury public relations, business aviation, private aircraft and helicopter charter services, and high-end client solutions.

We are looking for a highly skilled and result-oriented HR & Talent Acquisition Manager who can build a strong network of experienced professionals, freelance sales executives, business development specialists and industry-specific talent to support our business growth.

* Develop and execute recruitment strategies for both businesses.

**2. Industry-Specific Hiring**

For BRU CHARTERS:

* Recruit candidates with experience in business aviation, private jet charter, helicopter charter, corporate travel, luxury travel and aviation sales.

* Source suitable candidates for corporate charter enquiries, helicopter charter sales and medical evacuation business development.

For Luxuryline PR:

* Recruit professionals experienced in luxury brand PR, client servicing, corporate partnerships, business development, event management and premium-brand sales.
* Identify candidates with strong networking, communication, presentation and relationship-management skills.

**3. Freelance Sales Network Development**

* Establish a structured freelance recruitment and onboarding process.
* Explain commission structures, performance expectations and contractual terms before onboarding.
* Develop a database of qualified candidates and maintain accurate recruitment records.
* Monitor candidate activation, sales enquiries and recruitment quality.

**4. Screening & Assessment**

* Conduct preliminary interviews and competency-based assessments.
* Verify employment history, relevant experience and professional references where appropriate.
* Assess communication, negotiation, client acquisition and relationship-building skills.
* Prioritize quality, integrity and demonstrable performance over candidate volume.

**5. HR Operations & Reporting**

* Maintain candidate pipelines, interview schedules and recruitment reports.
* Coordinate onboarding, training and performance reviews.
* Work closely with management to identify staffing requirements.
* Track time-to-hire, recruitment costs, candidate retention and active sales performance.
* Ensure compliance with applicable employment, freelance contracting and data-protection requirements.

* Excellent communication, interviewing, negotiation and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and build a large candidate pipeline.

* Number of qualified candidates interviewed and successfully onboarded.
* Progress toward the 100-candidate freelance sales recruitment target.
* Recruitment turnaround time and cost per successful hire.
* Candidate activation and retention.
* Contribution of recruited sales professionals to qualified enquiries and business development.

Salary or compensation will be based on experience, recruitment expertise and demonstrated results. Performance-linked incentives may be considered against clearly defined and achievable KPIs.

Interested candidates should share their updated CV along with details of their recruitment experience, industries handled, sales-profile hiring experience and major hiring achievements.

title: Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L1)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you will be the first point of contact for our clients, ensuring their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You will proactively identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, focusing on first-line support for standard and low-complexity incidents and service requests. Your aim? To ensure zero missed service level agreement conditions.  
  
Every day, you will monitor client infrastructure and solutions, identifying problems and errors before or as they occur. You will dive deep into first-line incidents assigned to you, pinpointing the root causes, and providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support to our clients when they need it most. Maintenance activities, such as patching and configuration changes, will be part of your routine, ensuring the smooth operation of client systems.  
  
You will work across two or more technology domains, such as Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications, or Collaboration. Your day may include updating existing knowledge articles or creating new ones, seeking opportunities for work optimization, and supporting project work as needed. Additionally, you will contribute to disaster recovery functions and tests, ensuring our clients' DATA is safe and sound.  
  
Shift changes are made seamless with your careful handovers, ensuring service continuity. You will report and escalate incidents when necessary and strive for efficient, comprehensive resolutions of incidents and requests. With each interaction, you will aim to provide a positive client experience, placing their needs at the forefront of all you do.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Entry-level experience with troubleshooting and support in security, network, DATA centre, systems, or storage within a medium to large ICT organization.
* Basic knowledge of management agents, redundancy concepts, and ITIL processes.
* Highly disciplined in handling of tickets on day-to-day basis. Act promptly as per defined Sop’s.
* Try to resolve as many tickets as possible using available Knowledge articles or provided Sop’s.
* Good understanding of using ITSM tools.
* Skill in planning activities and projects in advance and adapting to changing circumstances.
* A client-centric approach, understanding their requirements and ensuring a positive experience throughout their journey.
* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Proficiency in active listening techniques and refraining from interrupting.
* A positive outlook at work, even in pressurized environments.
* Willingness to work hard and put in longer hours when necessary.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT or Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).

**Workplace type****:**

On-site Working

**About NTT DATA**  
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more

than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as

established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each

year in R&D.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

**Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**

NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an **@nttdata.com** email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please *contact us*.

title: CRM Executive
description:
usiness Development & Talent Acquisition

**Employment Type:** Full-time

Role Overview

We are looking for an entrepreneurial and performance-driven **360° Recruitment Consultant** to spearhead both client acquisition and end-to-end recruitment delivery. In this dual-impact role, you will identify and onboard corporate clients who need hiring solutions, while directly managing the complete talent search and selection lifecycle to fulfill those mandates.

Key Responsibilities1. Client Acquisition & Lead Generation (B2B Sales)

* Identify, research, and prospect potential B2B clients (startups, SMEs, and mid-to-large enterprises) looking for recruitment and staffing support.
* Execute multi-channel outreach campaigns via cold calling, cold emailing, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and networking.
* Manage, update, and track all leads, deals, and communication pipelines using CRM software (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce).
* Pitch recruitment service offerings, negotiate terms of business (service fee margins, replacement guarantees), and close Master Service Agreements (MSAs).
* Maintain ongoing client relationships to drive repeat business, account expansion, and referrals.

2. Full-Lifecycle Recruitment & Mandate Fulfillment

* Take detailed job briefings from clients to understand technical requirements, culture fit, compensation bands, and turnaround expectations.
* Source passive and active candidates across multiple channels (Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, internal databases, and direct headhunting).
* Screen CVs, conduct preliminary behavioural and technical assessments, and prepare candidate submission summaries.
* Coordinate client-candidate interview rounds, manage feedback loops, and resolve candidate hesitations.
* Lead salary negotiations, extend offers, and manage candidate engagement up to day-one joining to minimise dropouts.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* **Experience:** 2–5 years of proven experience in an agency, consultancy, or staffing firm handling both business development and candidate delivery (360° recruitment model).
* **CRM & ATS Expertise:** Hands-on experience working with CRM systems (HubSpot, Zoho CRM, etc.) and recruitment applicant tracking systems (Zoho Recruit, Ceipal, Bullhorn, or similar).
* **Sourcing Skills:** Expertise in Boolean search strings, Naukri portal operations, LinkedIn Recruiter, and headhunting techniques.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Strong understanding of staffing business metrics, recruitment margins, contract negotiations, and client management.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written English communication, presentation, and objection-handling skills.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Marketing, or a related field.

Key Competencies

* B2B Lead Generation & Cold Outreach
* CRM Pipeline Management
* End-to-End Candidate Lifecycle Management
* Contract & Salary Negotiation
* Client Relationship & Stakeholder Management
* Time Management & Mandate Prioritisation

What We Offer

* Competitive base salary with an attractive, uncapped commission/incentive structure on both client acquisition and candidate placements.
* Fast-track career growth into lead/managerial roles.
* Collaborative and high-ownership work environment.

Pay: ₹11,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Talent Acquisition Lead, AI-Enabled Recruiting
description:
**Job Title:** Talent Lead, AI-Enabled Recruiting

**Location:** India, Fully Remote

**Hours:** U.S. working hours (EST)

**Base compensation: $15,000 / year**

**Current incentive:**

* Internal hire: **US$300** when a hire completes the 3-month probation period, plus up to **US$200** based on the 90-day quality rating
* External placements: Up to **US$1,000** per successful placement, based on client acceptance and quality or retention milestones

  

Ajaia is an AI implementation consultancy and product studio. We are hiring a recruiter who wants to build, not just fill requisitions.

You will recruit engineers, AI consultants, strategists, operators, and client talent globally. You will also build the system Ajaia uses to define great people, assess them with evidence, and train hiring managers. Over time, that system becomes a recruiting service we offer to clients.

**Your mission:** build Ajaia into an A-player talent machine. Find exceptional people, assess them with evidence, help hiring managers decide better, and create an AI-enabled recruiting system that improves with every hire.

  

**What you will own**
---------------------

* Full-cycle recruiting across engineering, AI consulting, strategy, operations, and selected client roles.
* Direct sourcing and headhunting. You find passive candidates; you do not wait for applicants.
* Role scorecards that define the mission, measurable outcomes, and competencies for each hire.
* Structured screens, career interviews, focused interviews, and reference calls.
* Practical assessments and work samples that test whether a candidate can do the job.
* Trial-week design and operations for applicable in-person roles.
* Training hiring managers to interview and evaluate consistently.
* Always-on talent pipelines for recurring roles.
* AI workflows for sourcing, research, interview preparation, matching, documentation, and reporting.
* A future recruiting-as-a-service motion that matches Ajaia-vetted candidates with external companies.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* 50 successful hires over 18 months, counted after each hire completes the 3-month probation period.
* At least 50% of priority roles filled within 30 days, and 80% within 50 days.
* Hiring managers rate the candidates you present at least 8 out of 10 on average.
* New hires are measured at 90 and 180 days against the scorecard they were hired for.
* Within 60 days, AI is embedded in the recruiting workflow in ways that improve real output.
* Within 90 days, Ajaia has a working recruiting system: scorecards, interview guides, assessments, references, templates, training, and metrics.
* Within 90 days, we begin matching vetted candidates to external companies and roles.

**Experience that translates well**
-----------------------------------

* Agency recruiting or headhunting with strong direct sourcing.
* Startup recruiting across several functions.
* Technical sourcing, with the range to grow into full-cycle recruiting.
* Executive search research or assessment work.
* Client-facing recruiting or staffing where you had to sell talent.
* An adjacent role where you can prove research, sales, interviewing, operations, and AI ability.

  

**Ajaia's hiring process**

* A structured introductory screen on your goals, strengths, weaknesses, recruiting metrics, and track record.
* A live practical exercise. You build a role scorecard, create a sourcing strategy, evaluate sample candidates, run a short mock screen, and show how you use AI.
* A chronological interview covering your major roles, results, setbacks, working relationships, and reasons for leaving.
* Focused interviews on sourcing, judgment, communication, high agency, systems thinking, AI fluency, and commercial ability.
* Detailed reference calls with former managers and colleagues before the final decision.

  

*Ajaia moves quickly. Priorities change, expectations are high, and feedback is direct. In return, you get unusual scope, visibility, and room to build.*

title: Global Talent Acquisition Partner

Globalli is seeking an experienced Global Talent Acquisition Partner to join our People team and support hiring across our growing, multinational organization. The ideal candidate understands how recruiting works in a multinational environment and can adapt sourcing and hiring practices to different talent markets while maintaining a consistent, high\-quality candidate experience.



You will manage the recruiting process from role intake and sourcing through interviews, offer coordination, and onboarding handoff, while keeping hiring managers informed and ensuring our ATS and recruiting data remain accurate and current.


**What You'll Do**



Global Talent Acquisition


* Manage full\-cycle recruiting for roles across Technology, Go\-to\-Market, HR/Workforce Management, and corporate functions.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs, define role requirements, establish interview processes, and develop realistic hiring timelines.
* Develop sourcing strategies based on the role, location, seniority, and local talent market.

* Manage offer processes in partnership with the HR Manager and hiring managers.
* Complete recruiting activities and provide a clear handoff to HR for onboarding and new hire setup.
* Maintain consistent communication with candidates throughout the process and help deliver a strong candidate experience.

* Understand how recruiting practices, talent availability, compensation expectations, employment considerations, and time zones can differ by market.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines in both established and emerging hiring markets.
* Coordinate effectively with candidates and hiring managers across multiple time zones.

* Track recruiting activity and provide regular reporting on pipeline health, time\-to\-fill, offers, hiring activity, and sourcing effectiveness.

* Maintain organized recruiting documentation and ensure processes are followed consistently.
